title: Active Permission Flags
description: In a secure operating system, a user's permissions are represented as a 32-bit integer. Write a function that takes this unsigned 32-bit integer and returns the total number of active permission bits (bits set to 1) it contains.
output_format: An integer representing the count of set bits.

examples.explanation: Binary representation of 11 is 1011, which has 3 set bits.
Binary representation of 128 is 10000000, which has 1 set bit.
